intro: This page lists MBA colleges accepting Rajasthan MAT 2026 from our historical exam tags. Before you apply, you need to know that the standalone Rajasthan Management Admission Test is no longer the official route.

We currently link {{count}} MBA / PGDM programme options at {{colleges}} colleges, most of them in Rajasthan. {{published}} of those colleges have a published profile, including {{public}} public institutes.

Rajasthan Technical University now points MBA admission in its university department to RMAP, the Rajasthan Management Admission Process. Confirm the current test or counselling on the college and RTU or CEG notices.
listLead: The cards follow our usual order, with ranked and published profiles first. Many rows have no fee or placement on file, and the exam tag may be older than the current Rajasthan admission process.
snapshot: Seventeen of the colleges we can place are in Rajasthan, with Jaipur, Alwar and Udaipur appearing most often. That matches a state-level list, but it does not prove that Rajasthan MAT is still being held.
Too few colleges here have a recorded package for a stable median, so we have not quoted one in this text. Read each placement year, if any, as a historical figure only.
If you are comparing top MBA / PGDM colleges in India 2026, treat this page as a shortlist of Rajasthan campuses, then verify the live admission route before you pay an application fee.
firstCollegesLead: Most of the first cards have no main-programme fee and no placement year in our table. That is a data gap, not a sign that the course is free.
One exception in our records is the College of Technology and Engineering, Udaipur, with a recorded MBA fee of ₹50,000 and a 2023 average package of ₹4 LPA. Confirm both on the official notice.

sections.heading: What replaced Rajasthan MAT in official notices
paragraphs: RMAT was historically associated with Rajasthan Technical University, Kota. We could not find a current official RMAT 2026 information bulletin from RTU.

RTU's University Teaching Department now says MBA admission is conducted through RMAP, a coordinating body for MBA admissions in the state. Colleges may also use national tests such as CMAT, so check each campus.
bullets: Use the college's latest admission page, not only the older Rajasthan MAT tag in our list.
Look for RMAP or CEG, Jaipur, notices if you want a centralised Rajasthan MBA counselling route.
Eligibility is still usually a three-year bachelor's degree; the exact percentage is set in the current official notice.

compare.heading: How to shortlist MBA colleges accepting Rajasthan MAT 2026
paragraphs: Use this list to find Rajasthan campuses, then switch to the official 2026–27 admission notice before you apply.
These checks will save you a wasted application:
bullets: Whether the college still mentions Rajasthan MAT, or now asks for RMAP, CMAT or its own process.
Government versus private status, and whether the fee on file is for the full programme.
Placement years, if any; some of our figures are from 2023 and are historical, not a promise.
Location and hostel, because this list is spread across Jaipur, Alwar, Udaipur, Ajmer, Bikaner and Kota.

faqs.question: Is Rajasthan MAT still conducted in 2026?
faqs.answer: We could not find a current official RMAT 2026 bulletin from RTU. RTU's University Teaching Department now points MBA admission to RMAP, the Rajasthan Management Admission Process. Confirm the live route before you apply.

faqs.question: How many colleges are on this Rajasthan MAT list?
faqs.answer: Our records still tag {{count}} MBA / PGDM programme options at {{colleges}} colleges, of which {{published}} are published. That tag may be older than the current admission process.

faqs.question: What is RMAP?
faqs.answer: RMAP is the Rajasthan Management Admission Process. RTU's official university-department page says MBA admission there is conducted by RMAP. Other colleges may join a centralised process or run their own.

faqs.question: Which cities appear most often on this list?
faqs.answer: In our records, Jaipur, Alwar and Udaipur have the most colleges. The list also includes campuses in Ajmer, Bhilwara, Bikaner and Kota. Check each college's current admission notice.

faqs.question: Can I use the fees and packages on this page as final?
faqs.answer: No. Many colleges here have no fee or package on file. Where a figure exists, such as a ₹50,000 MBA fee at the College of Technology and Engineering, Udaipur, confirm it on the official fee notice.
